known_debt: Zero test sources in all five Java services; only one spec file in the frontend. The build workflow is the only automated signal.
.mvn/wrapper/ was never committed to any Java repo, so ./mvnw cannot bootstrap. Use mvn.
global-bank-frontend is still Angular 9.1.13 and has not been modernised.
The five Java services no longer have Dockerfiles or k8s manifests; only the frontend does.
Inter-service URLs are now env vars (CUSTOMER_SERVICE_URL etc.) defaulting to localhost; the Deployment must supply Service DNS names.
authentication's jwt.secret now comes from JWT_SECRET and must be provided by a Kubernetes Secret in any real deployment.
Lombok was removed fleet-wide: 1.18.38 is the newest release and does not support JDK 25. It can return once a supporting version ships.
